ImageConfig.description: Image optimization configuration for the project.

remoteDomains.description: Hostnames whose remote (https) images are optimized through /cdn-cgi/image transform URLs (cloudflare service only), e.g. ["drive.usercontent.google.com"]. Remote sources from other hosts are left untouched.

service.description: How images are optimized: "build" runs Sharp at build time; "cloudflare" emits /cdn-cgi/image transform URLs served by Cloudflare Image Transformations (requires the feature to be enabled on the serving zone).

JxFieldSchema.description: A single field definition inside a section entry schema — a small, recursive subset of JSON Schema. Recursive positions reference the effective field union via the well-known fields resource $id.

RelationshipRef.description: Relationship reference field: points at a named entry of a referenceable section via "#/<sectionKey>/<name>" (specs/relationships.md). A bare reference is to-one; wrap in an array field's items for to-many.

description: Core fragment of the Jx project.json schema. Open by design: extension fragments contribute their own top-level sections and the generated per-project entry document (project.schema.json) closes the composition. See specs/extensions.md §5.

$defs.description: Global type definitions available to all pages.

$elements.description: Global custom element dependencies available to all pages. Items are $ref objects or npm package specifier strings.

$head.description: Global <head> entries applied to all pages. Array of element definitions for meta tags, link tags, script tags, etc.

$media.description: Named media breakpoints following CSS @custom-media convention. Available in all component style objects.

$schema.description: Relative path to the generated per-project schema (conventionally ./project.schema.json, written by `jx schema`).

deploy.description: Deployment tracking: the hosting project this repo publishes to. Identifiers only (no secrets) — safe to commit; Studio uses it to tell whether the publish workflow already exists. `adapter` says how the build is packaged; `deploy` says where it ships.

accountId.description: Hosting account id (e.g. the Cloudflare account id).

productionUrl.description: Production URL of the connected hosting project.

projectName.description: Hosting project name (e.g. the Cloudflare Pages project).

provider.description: Hosting provider the project is connected to.

format.description: Reserved; currently unused. Accepted for forward compatibility with single-file output (desktop single-file mode) — the build emits per-route directories regardless.

sitemap.description: Generate sitemap.xml from the route table (requires `url`). Set false to disable.

trailingSlash.description: Trailing slash behavior for generated URLs.

copy.description: Declarative file copy map. Keys are source paths (relative to project root), values are destination paths (relative to outDir).

defaults.description: Default settings applied to all pages unless overridden.

lang.description: Default lang attribute for the <html> element.

layout.description: Default layout file path applied to all pages. Set to null to render pages without a layout.

extensions.description: Extension packages: bare package names (resolved project-first through the package exports map) or relative paths. Each must export jx-extension.json.

imports.description: Global import map: $prototype names to .class.json file paths. Makes external classes available by name in all pages.

redirects.description: Static redirect rules. Maps source paths to destination paths.

state.description: Site-wide reactive state available to all pages.

style.description: Global CSS styles applied to the <body> element. Uses the same camelCase CSSOM convention as component styles.

url.description: Production URL of the deployed site.
